description: Update/upgrade an existing Gambot AI brain. PATCH semantics — only the fields you pass change; everything else (including learned Q&A, style examples and the knowledge-base file) is kept. Use this to refine the auto-built AI: sharpen its purpose/instructions, set the tone or language, add Q&A, or toggle escalate-to-human.

botInstructions.description: Free-text system instructions that steer how the AI answers.

botPurpose.description: What the AI is for (e.g. customer support, FAQ, sales).

escalateToHuman.description: Hand off to a human agent when the AI can't help.

id.description: The Gambot AI model id (from gambot_list_ai).

qnAPairs.description: Knowledge Q&A pairs (REPLACES the live set — send the full list you want).

name: gambot_update_ai
title: Update (upgrade) Gambot AI model
